correction.scientific_rationale: The v1/v2 all-fold checkpoint audit deliberately measured masked-argmax checkpoint behavior, but the already qualified production generator uses branch-run feasibility limits and stochastic terminal bond decoding. Final checkpoint selection must therefore be repeated on a new independent program draw under the exact production decoder. The argmax result remains a disclosed diagnostic and cannot freeze the production checkpoint.

unconditional_program_prior.source: new independent draw from the unchanged training-fold, source- and family-balanced program prior

production_refit_interpretation: Apply every inherited validity, exact-L1, open-endedness, collapse and descriptor-realism gate without modification.
Bind the already qualified branch-run limits and bond-stochastic terminal decoder before opening checkpoint outputs.
Select among passing checkpoints by the inherited paired usable-open-ended-yield, realism, exact-reproduction and earliest-noninferior rules.
Do not use the earlier argmax checkpoint result or decreasing all-fold training loss as final production selection evidence.
